properties.name: STATE_TOTALITY
properties.requirement: Every reachable nonterminal state and legal observation has a next transition.

properties.name: TRANSITION_DETERMINISM
properties.requirement: A state and observation produce exactly one action decision.

properties.name: COMMIT_SOUNDNESS
properties.requirement: Navigation commit requires C0 PASS, L2 PASS, L3 WITNESS_FOUND, and prerequisites.

properties.name: NO_POSTCOMMIT_CERTIFICATION_IN_ACTIVE_MODE
properties.requirement: Required active checks occur before plant commit.

properties.name: ALTERNATIVE_RECERTIFICATION
properties.requirement: Every alternative commit traverses C0, L2, and L3.

properties.name: NO_ALTERNATIVE_FOR_L1_FAIL
properties.requirement: L1 FAIL never enters alternative search.

properties.name: UNKNOWN_IS_NOT_FAIL_OR_FREE
properties.requirement: UNKNOWN is neither PASS nor candidate-unsafe FAIL.

properties.name: UNKNOWN_SCOPE_ROUTING
properties.requirement: Global and candidate-local UNKNOWN routes remain distinct.

properties.name: BACKUP_AVAILABILITY_FOR_NAV_COMMIT
properties.requirement: Navigation commit creates the next-cycle fallback token.

properties.name: BACKUP_RETENTION
properties.requirement: A valid old backup is retained until a new witness is ready.

properties.name: ATOMIC_BACKUP_HANDOFF
properties.requirement: Old-to-new replacement has no NONE gap.

properties.name: DEADLINE_CLOSURE
properties.requirement: At guard the supervisor selects a certified action or explicit assurance boundary.

properties.name: TERMINAL_PRIORITY_SOUNDNESS
properties.requirement: Terminal membership cannot preempt available certified navigation when the goal is not reached.

properties.name: BOUNDED_ALTERNATIVE_SEARCH
properties.requirement: Alternative search terminates within the finite budget and guard.

properties.name: FAILURE_EXCLUSIVITY
properties.requirement: Candidate, global, deadline, map, and authority routes do not masquerade as each other.

properties.name: INITIAL_RUNTIME_REPAIR_SEPARATION
properties.requirement: Runtime failure never invokes initialization projection.

properties.name: TEMPORAL_SEGMENT_CONTIGUITY
properties.requirement: L1, L2, and backup handoff have no index gap or unintended duplicate.

properties.name: ASSURANCE_BOUNDARY_EXPLICIT
properties.requirement: No certified action produces OUTSIDE_METHOD rather than a fictional safe stop.

properties.name: SAFETY_LIVENESS_SEPARATION
properties.requirement: Backup or terminal action does not itself assert task success.

properties.name: RECURSIVE_HANDOFF
properties.requirement: Navigation commit carries a valid next-cycle fallback or equivalent certified continuation.
